## Exclusions

- `crates/pun-fixers/src/fixers/normalize_index_brace.rs:23-31` fix body: the `$a{1}` index-brace tokens come only from PHP < 8 syntax, which no longer parses (upstream's fixtures for it all require PHP < 8.0).
- `crates/pun-fixers/src/fixers/yoda_style.rs:421` the same `$a{0}` block type.
- `crates/pun-fixers/src/fixers/pint_laravel_blade/php_block_formatting.rs:221` the fallback when a formatted directive argument has no balanced `(...)`: the argument was cut out balanced, and formatting either leaves it unchanged or keeps it balanced.
- `crates/pun-cli/src/run.rs:765` the `Status::Lint` arm (fixers produced code that no longer parses): no known input makes the ported fixers emit a parse error. pun-format's tests reach `after_fix` with a test fixer.
- `crates/pun-cli/src/run.rs:745-747` a lint error other than a syntax error (`FixBrokeSyntax`, `NoConvergence`): no known input triggers either. pun-lint's tests reach both with test rules.
- `crates/pun-cli/src/run.rs:1025` the panic hook's call of the default hook: only a Pun bug panics outside a file's isolated fixing.
- `crates/pun-cli/src/run.rs:461` the project scan thread's panic, resumed on the lint thread: the scan runs no fixer, so only a Pun bug panics there.
- `crates/pun-cli/src/lib.rs:331` `main`'s resume of a panic on the run thread: as for the panic hook, only a Pun bug reaches it.
- `crates/pun-cli/src/watch.rs:46` the watch channel's `Disconnected`: the watcher holds the sender for as long as the loop runs.
- `crates/pun-phpstan/src/resolve.rs:58` a global type alias that refers to itself: PHPStan stops with an internal error; Pun resolves `*ERROR*` instead of recursing.
- `crates/pun-phpstan/src/resolve.rs:1055` a `true`/`false`/`null`/array constant expression as a type: PHPStan stops with an internal error on it; Pun resolves `*ERROR*`.
- `crates/pun-cli/src/migrate.rs:596` `closest_preset`'s "nothing to switch" return: every PHPStan level leaves some rules of its closest Pun preset off, so a migrated `[analyse]` always has on/off lines.
- `crates/pun-cli/src/migrate.rs:568` the same: the `[analyse]` line without on/off counts.
- `crates/pun-cli/src/update.rs:549` `require -p`'s second resolution failing: it uses constraints that the first solution's versions satisfy.
- `crates/pun-packages/src/store.rs:200` a copy-on-write clone that succeeds: `FICLONE` works only on btrfs, XFS and bcachefs; orbs and CI run on overlayfs and ext4. The refusal and the copy after it are covered.
- `crates/pun-packages/src/store.rs:228` the same: the `FICLONE` ioctl's success.
- `crates/pun-packages/src/plugin_host.rs:36` the downloaded composer.phar's checksum mismatch: only a tampered or truncated download reaches it, and the tests download from the real server.
- `crates/pun-analyse/src/rules/return_types.rs:77-79` `Provider::meta()` of the built-in return provider: Mago's `PluginRegistry` reads `meta()` only for its own library plugins.
- `crates/pun-analyse/src/rules/return_types.rs:1275-1277` the same for the benevolent-return provider.
- `crates/pun-analyse/src/rules/return_types.rs:1316-1318` the same for the Closure method return provider.
- `crates/pun-analyse/src/rules/larastan/relations.rs:168` a relation method declared by one of PHP's own classes: a model extends Eloquent's Model, which extends none of them.
- `crates/pun-analyse/src/laravel/mod.rs:761-768` `Provider::meta()` of the model-attribute hook: `PluginRegistry` never reads it for a registered expression hook, and the hook struct is private.
- `crates/pun-analyse/src/mockery.rs:200-202` `Provider::meta()` of the `Mockery::mock()` return provider: `PluginRegistry` reads `meta()` only for its own library plugins.
- `crates/pun-analyse/src/mockery.rs:311-313` the same for the `allows()`/`expects()` return provider.
- `crates/pun-analyse/src/mockery.rs:339` the `allows()`/`expects()` provider's receiver that is no object: only a static call `MockInterface::allows()` has one, and Pun's analyser stops that call to an instance method as `*ERROR*` before it asks providers (tests/fixtures/mockery/gaps.txt, Intersections.php:44).
- `crates/pun-analyse/src/mockery.rs:427` the empty `AnalyseExtension::load()`: Pun calls `load()` only on Larastan.
- `crates/pun-analyse/src/rules/infer.rs:584-588` the same for the definedness hook.
- `crates/pun-analyse/src/rules/larastan/forwards.rs:1373-1375` the same for the `builder-of` call hook.
- `crates/pun-analyse/src/rules/regex_shapes/mod.rs:39-41` `Provider::meta()` of the preg_replace_callback() closure-type provider: read only for library plugins.
- `crates/pun-analyse/src/rules/regex_shapes/mod.rs:106-108` the same for the preg_match() shape provider.
- `crates/pun-analyse/src/rules/enum_methods.rs:34-36` the same for the enum `cases()`/`from()`/`tryFrom()` return provider.
- `crates/pun-analyse/src/mago.rs:74` the fallback that skips only a file on which Mago's analyzer panics: no known input triggers it. It stays as a guard against unexpected upstream failures.
- `crates/pun-analyse/src/rules/types/convert.rs:912` a symbolic class-constant array key (`array{Foo::BAR: int}`): known literal keys are resolved before conversion, and no public input is known to carry an unresolved one here. The fallback returns `Error`.
- `crates/pun-phpstan/src/symbols.rs:172-174` `Visitor::expecting()` of the symbols.json map reader: serde calls it only for malformed input, and symbols.json is compiled in.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/laravel/prefer_nullsafe.rs:49` non-target node guard: `Linter` dispatches only MethodCall and PropertyAccess, as `targets()` requires.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/laravel/prefer_env_helper.rs:34` non-target node guard: only ArrayAccess is dispatched.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/php_8_4/add_csv_escape_argument.rs:72` non-target node guard: only FunctionCall and MethodCall.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/control_flow/no_assign_in_condition.rs:43` non-target node guard: only the condition-holding nodes `targets()` lists.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/dead_code/no_bool_ternary.rs:34` non-target node guard: only Conditional.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/complexity/no_boolean_literal_compare.rs:33` non-target node guard: only Binary.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/complexity/no_compact.rs:35` non-target node guard: only FunctionCall.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/dead_code/no_false_ternary.rs:33` non-target node guard: only Conditional.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/dead_code/no_redundant_property_default.rs:49` non-target node guard: only Class and AnonymousClass.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/complexity/no_redundant_write_visibility.rs:32` non-target node guard: only Property.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/complexity/no_sole_value_sprintf.rs:35` non-target node guard: only FunctionCall.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/dead_code/no_unused_expression.rs:48` non-target node guard: only ExpressionStatement.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/dead_code/no_unused_private_method_param.rs:45` non-target node guard: only Class and AnonymousClass.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/dead_code/no_unused_private_property.rs:57` non-target node guard: only Class and AnonymousClass.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/dead_code/no_useless_ternary.rs:42` non-target node guard: only Conditional.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/complexity/prefer_min_max.rs:33` non-target node guard: only Conditional.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/complexity/prefer_property_default.rs:40` non-target node guard: only Class and AnonymousClass.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/style/require_assign_set_padding.rs:45` non-target node guard: only Function, Method and Closure.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/complexity/require_is_a_allow_string.rs:34` non-target node guard: only FunctionCall.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/dead_code/no_empty_loop.rs:42` the loop guard: only loop statements are dispatched, and their parent is always a Statement under some node.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/dead_code/no_empty_loop.rs:45` the loop guard: `parts()` gives `None` only for a non-loop statement.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/dead_code/no_empty_loop.rs:130` the same: the non-loop arm of `parts()`.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/support/scope_usage.rs:36` the non-function arm of `function_like_body()`: callers pass only functions, methods and closures.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/types/add_closure_never_return.rs:34` non-target node guard: only Closure.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/types/add_closure_return.rs:51` non-target node guard: only Closure.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/types/add_closure_return.rs:123` non-target node guard: only ArrowFunction.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/types/add_closure_void_return.rs:35` non-target node guard: only Closure.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/types/add_function_void_return.rs:35` non-target node guard: only Function.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/types/add_magic_method_types.rs:41` non-target node guard: only Method.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/types/add_method_void_return.rs:41` non-target node guard: only Method.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/types/add_method_void_return.rs:48` a method with no class scope: a method is always inside a class-like.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/types/add_fluent_return.rs:45` the same: a method with no class scope.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/types/add_never_return.rs:66` non-target node guard: only Function and Method.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/types/add_return_type_from_param.rs:47` non-target node guard: only Function and Method.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/support/values.rs:121` a scope without a Program ancestor: `known()` walks up to the file, which is always there.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/support/values.rs:134` `top_level()` of a scope `known()` never passes (only functions, concrete methods and the file).
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/support/names.rs:404` a scope without a Program ancestor: lookups start inside the file's walk.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/support/syntax_types.rs:113` `parameter()`'s `unreachable!()` arm: `rposition` selects only the four function-like kinds the match handles.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/types/names.rs:20` a scope without a Program ancestor.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/dead_code/no_unused_private_property.rs:383` an ExpressionStatement whose parent is not a Statement: the parser always wraps it in one.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/complexity/prefer_property_default.rs:143` overlapping edits: the removed constructor assignment and the added property default are never in the same place.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/types/add_return_type_from_ternary.rs:67` a ternary whose native type has `mixed`: no input found; Mago types no `mixed` branch here.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/types/add_return_type_from_property.rs:79` a `mixed` returned type: `typed_property()` already refuses a `mixed` property.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/types/facts.rs:716` LLVM's closing-brace region for missing native artifacts after a Mago analyzer error or panic: no deterministic input is known. It stays as a containment boundary.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/types/declare.rs:101` an empty type list: callers pass non-empty native types.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/types/declare.rs:168` `void` as a declaration: callers drop `void` first.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/types/declare.rs:202` an intersection with a non-object member: Mago builds intersections only of object types.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/types/declare.rs:351` `void`, `mixed` or `null` (below 7.1) in a union: `add_union_return` refuses `mixed`/`void` first, and the union rule needs PHP 8.0.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/types/mod.rs:370` `unreachable!()` after the class-like kinds `rposition` matched.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/types/never.rs:190` a method with no class scope (see add_method_void_return).
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/types/never.rs:197` a named class the codebase lacks: the codebase is built from this file, which declares it.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/laravel/prefer_request_server.rs:34` non-target node guard: only ArrayAccess.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/laravel/prefer_sleep_facade.rs:33` non-target node guard: only ExpressionStatement.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/laravel/names.rs:20` a scope without a Program ancestor: every lookup comes from a parsed file's walk.
- `crates/pun-lint/src/rules/laravel/prefer_facade_over_app.rs:29` non-target node guard: only FunctionCall.

## Known deviation from Pint

- `--preset=<unknown>`: the pinned Pint phar crashes with "Undefined array key" instead of "Preset not found."; Pun prints "Preset not found.", and its test checks Pun's message on its own.
